conventions.coords: game tile coords from tape units channel (10 Hz)
conventions.theta: atan2(y-Cy, x-Cx), unwrapped; positive dtheta = CCW in game-coord math convention = CLOCKWISE on the game screen (iso mapping sx=x-y, sy=(x+y)/2, screen y down)
conventions.center: midpoint of side centroids at first frame with both sides present
conventions.corner: kiter centroid within 2 tiles of bbox(all unit samples) edge, over final 25% of kiter-alive frames
conventions.reload_gap: mean delta of nearest-enemy distance between consecutive missile fires of the same kiter unit (volleys collapsed at 0.2s, dt filtered to 0.5x..2x median)
